_about: Whose copy this is. storage: "github" commits synced data to repo (needs a token in the browser); "browser" keeps each visitor's data in their own browser. app = this site's address + ?sync=1 (used by the Sync bookmark). duprId / duprCode pin the bookmark to one player; leave both empty to sync whoever is logged in to DUPR. After editing, run: python tools/build_bookmarklet.py
